gaps: Emotionally dramatized versions of festival kathas focusing on interpersonal human dynamics (e.g., sister vs sister-in-law, greed vs devotion) rather than plain ritual narrations.
Lesser-known folklore dev-bhakt characters (like Adhaiya Brahman) presented in long-form animation storytelling.
saturated: Standard daily Navratri Vrat Kathas without unique narrative angles (e.g., Maa Katyayani or Maa Siddhidatri day-by-day stories performing as low as 0.07x-0.11x).
Generic musical tracks or bhajan uploads on storytelling channels (Janmashtami HD song at 0.01x).
Dry biographical summaries of saints or temples without dramatic conflict (Neem Karoli Baba at 0.05x, Tirupati Balaji at 0.01x).
